urgency.note: Urgency precision is reported against the project-set target; recall, exact agreement, and prioritization trade-offs remain diagnostic.

route_quality.note: Trade-offs are measured at the frozen policy threshold. The unsafe-automation route count means a draft route where the label expects escalation; drafts remain unsent, and automatic sends are checked separately. No route-accuracy cutoff is specified.

answerability.note: This compares answerable_from_docs labels with the persisted routing evidence_ready signal. It measures evidence availability, not semantic answerability; retrieval_hit_rate separately checks expected document IDs. Missing readiness remains in the labeled denominator as an unavailable prediction and is counted above.

semantic_citation_support.reason: This mechanical source-integrity section does not assess semantic support. See evaluation.criteria.llm_judge for the separate model-estimated sample.

whole_answer_correctness.reason: Whole-answer correctness is not mechanically established by citation integrity. See evaluation.criteria.llm_judge for the separate model-estimated sample.

human_rated_citation_accuracy.reason: Human-rated citation accuracy remains unmeasured; see evaluation.criteria.llm_judge for a separate model-estimated citation-support sample.

hallucination.reason: Mechanical excerpt matching does not establish hallucination. See evaluation.criteria.llm_judge for a separate model-estimated sample.

citation_source_integrity.note: Citation resolution, source eligibility, and exact excerpt checks are mechanical integrity checks. They do not establish semantic citation support, whole-answer correctness, or hallucination.

protected_case_safety.note: Every protected case must escalate and no ticket is automatically sent. Route deviations and automatic sends are reported separately; draft_for_review remains an unsent draft.

runtime_latency.note: Nearest-rank p95 of processing_latency_seconds, calculated as full per-ticket processing_duration_seconds through the matching SQLite result/audit commit minus only draft_generation_request_duration_seconds. Batch export and the post-run quality judge are reported separately; this is not customer response time.

availability.target: 99.5% availability target excluded from the Release 1 CLI gate under PRD v2.3
availability.note: A one-off batch has no uptime observation window or availability-event denominator. Batch completion is not availability.

private_data_output.target: 0 detected private-data occurrences in every generated draft
private_data_output.note: The output guardrail's blocked check count is used as the detected-occurrence count; every generated draft must have a recorded check.

decision_audit_coverage.target: exactly one matching persisted decision/audit record per processed ticket
decision_audit_coverage.note: Counts SQLite-backed decision events that match one result by input index, ticket ID, and action; requires complete result/input/audit reconciliation.

confidence_calibration.target: absolute confidence-to-accuracy error <= 5% per populated band
confidence_calibration.note: Compares mean confidence with observed intent accuracy separately in each populated confidence band.

group_quality_variation.note: Only intent, urgency, route, and evidence-readiness agreement label comparisons are used. A dimension is comparable when each named group has at least 5 labeled examples and no missing labels or evidence. These model measures do not represent realized customer outcomes.

business_outcomes.note: First-response time, first-contact resolution, satisfaction, actual escalation outcomes, repeat contacts, and resolution outcomes require downstream agent or customer actions this not-sent CLI does not perform. Historical fixtures remain labeled as baselines and are not scored as current-run performance.

limitations: Historical outcomes describe the fixture's prior support process and are not caused by this CLI run.

Scored per-ticket processing latency excludes only draft-generation request wait; generation-inclusive processing duration and request wait are reported separately. First-response time and first-contact resolution are unavailable because this CLI drafts or escalates and does not send or resolve tickets.
Historical resolution-time measures are fixture baselines, not response times caused by this CLI run.
Citation resolution and exact excerpt grounding are mechanical checks; semantic model-judged estimates are recorded separately in evaluation.criteria.llm_judge.
Customer satisfaction is historical fixture data; this run did not collect live customer feedback or human ratings.
